reference.code: pub fn clamped_slice(t:&str,mut s:i32,mut e:i32)->String{let r:Vec<_>=t.chars().collect();let n=r.len() as i32;if s<0{s+=n}if e<0{e+=n}s=s.clamp(0,n);e=e.clamp(0,n);if s>e{return String::new()}r[s as usize..e as usize].iter().collect()}
